description: Four-pole multimode filter with a VCA ahead of it, carrying lowpass at two slopes, bandpass, highpass and notch at once

params.text: Sets the cutoff frequency of the filter
Sets the resonance of the filter
Sets the gain of the VCA
Attenuates the pitch CV input, and at 100% the cutoff tracks that input at one volt per octave
Attenuates and inverts the frequency CV input
Attenuates and inverts the resonance CV input
Attenuates and inverts the VCA gain CV input

inputs.text: Moves the filter cutoff, one volt per octave with its attenuverter at 100%
Modulates the cutoff frequency, scaled by the attenuverter for it
Modulates the resonance, scaled by the attenuverter for it
Modulates the VCA gain, scaled by the attenuverter for it; with nothing patched here it takes whatever is at the frequency CV input
The audio input to the VCA
The audio input to the filter, which also carries the VCA output while no cable is patched into that jack

outputs.text: The VCA output, which is mixed into the filter input until a cable is patched here
The filter output at four poles, 24dB per octave lowpass
The filter output at two poles, 12dB per octave lowpass
The bandpass output of the filter
The highpass output of the filter
The notch output of the filter

notes: a polyphonic signal at an input is mixed down to one channel before it is processed
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
